evidence: backend/servers/reality-server/src/state.rs:855 — sso_sessions: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, PendingSsoSession>>> unbounded map, init empty at state.rs:991. Entries inserted on SSO initiation (routes/sso.rs:94), removed ONLY on successful callback lookup (routes/sso.rs:243).
10-minute expiry (routes/sso.rs:251-257) is enforced LAZILY after a callback removes the entry — no background sweeper / retain() proactively evicts.
Authorize/initiation endpoint is PUBLIC → unauthenticated caller can grow the map without bound → gradual memory-exhaustion DoS across the reality-server process.

CGNAT is the notable gap — internal services behind CGNAT space become SSRF pivots the current string-time check misses. IPv6-mapped path (lines 152-159) inherits the same omissions via reuse of ipv4_forbidden_reason.
Low severity because module doc (lines 13-15, 112-115) says the import worker MUST re-resolve+re-validate post-DNS — this is defense-in-depth, not sole control.
